Agent Sai Srinivasa runs a detective agency in Nellore, but he rarely has any cases to solve. One day, he is asked to investigate a case but he gets more than he bargained for.
Movie:- Agent Sai (Agent Sai Srinivasa Athreya)
Starcast:- Naveen Polishetty, Shruti Sharma, Shredha Rajagopalan
Creative Producer:- Manish Shah
Directed by:- Swaroop RSJ
Music by:- Mark K Robin
